content.value_statement: Medical device teams need clear MDR 2017/745 guidance across classification, evidence, and surveillance work. This skill structures compliance reviews and documentation planning.
actual_capabilities: Guides MDR Annex VIII device classification and conformity assessment route selection.
Outlines Annex II and Annex III technical documentation requirements.
Frames clinical evidence planning, PMCF needs, and clinical evaluation updates.
Supports UDI, EUDAMED, and economic operator obligation reviews.
Structures post-market surveillance, PSUR, incident reporting, and trend reporting planning.
Helps prepare notified body selection criteria and submission readiness checks.
limitations: Does not replace qualified legal, regulatory, clinical, or notified body advice.
Requires accurate device details, intended purpose, risk data, and market plans.
Does not verify current EU guidance unless paired with updated source review.
Cannot certify compliance or guarantee notified body acceptance.

use_cases.title: Classify a Device
use_cases.description: Review device duration, invasiveness, software role, and intended purpose to draft an MDR classification rationale.

use_cases.title: Plan Technical Documentation
use_cases.description: Map Annex II and Annex III documentation needs before a notified body submission or internal readiness review.

use_cases.title: Review Post-Market Obligations
use_cases.description: Define PMS, PMCF, PSUR, incident reporting, and trend reporting actions for an MDR compliance plan.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Classification Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you need an initial MDR class estimate.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me assess the likely MDR class for this device. Ask for missing details about intended purpose, invasiveness, duration, software role, and patient risk.

prompt_templates.title: Documentation Gap Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when preparing or updating a technical file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare our current technical documentation against MDR Annex II and Annex III. Identify missing sections, weak evidence, and priority actions.

prompt_templates.title: Clinical Evidence Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when planning CER, PMCF, or clinical investigation work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a clinical evidence strategy for this device under MDR. Include literature evidence, clinical evaluation, PMCF, and investigation triggers.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Submission Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform an MDR submission readiness review for this device. Cover classification, conformity route, GSPR evidence, UDI, PMS, PMCF, and notified body questions.

output_examples.input: A manufacturer asks whether a reusable surgical instrument can follow Class I self-certification.
output_examples.output: The response explains key classification factors, flags sterilization and measuring considerations, and lists evidence needed before confirming the route.

output_examples.input: A team has a technical file but no structured Annex III post-market surveillance plan.
output_examples.output: The response outlines PMS plan sections, reporting cadence, complaint inputs, trend reporting checks, and PSUR or PMS report expectations.

output_examples.input: A software device team needs to know whether clinical investigation is needed.
output_examples.output: The response reviews intended purpose, clinical claims, risk class, literature evidence, equivalence limits, and PMCF options.

best_practices: Provide device details, intended purpose, risk class assumptions, and markets before requesting advice.
Ask for cited MDR article, annex, or guidance references when decisions affect submissions.
Use outputs as a planning aid and verify final positions with qualified regulatory experts.
anti_patterns: Do not use generic prompts without device context or clinical claims.
Do not treat generated classification guidance as a final legal determination.
Do not rely on outdated guidance without checking current MDR and MDCG updates.

faq.question: What regulation does this skill focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on EU MDR 2017/745 for medical device compliance planning and documentation support.

faq.question: Can it determine a final device classification?
faq.answer: It can help draft a classification rationale, but final decisions need expert review and sometimes notified body input.

faq.question: Does it create technical documentation?
faq.answer: It can outline required sections, identify gaps, and help plan Annex II and Annex III documentation.

faq.question: Can it support clinical evidence planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It can frame clinical evaluation, literature evidence, PMCF, and clinical investigation considerations.

faq.question: Does it check current MDR guidance automatically?
faq.answer: No. Pair important guidance questions with current source review before acting on the result.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
